title: Dynamic placement: work containers by load
summary: One host agent pulls eligible coding, review, gate and post work against a shared host budget, using fresh Linux work containers, a Windows process executor and attempt-scoped credentials.

implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Host identity and shadow placement

Source: `docs/dynamic-placement/index.html` (AGT-3171). Read AGENTS.md, the relevant domain map, and AGT-3019 before editing. Use the Dossier recommendation as the working decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the selected option. Preserve Task Server attempt authority and platform-owned git operations.

## Deliver
Create one physical-host registration record and role/OS/architecture/executor/toolchain/provider/repository capability advertisement. Add a pure eligibility and preference calculation to the existing claim authority; warm repository mirrors are a bounded tie-breaker, not a hard requirement. Join the AGT-3019 recommended host allocation version to claim admission without creating a new capacity store. Record matched requirements, rejected reasons, host, grant, lease, fence and epoch. Run in shadow mode before changing admissions.

## Acceptance
Mixed Linux/Windows fixtures reject role, OS, toolchain, provider or repository mismatches. An eligible cold host can claim after the configured warm-preference window; queue age prevents starvation. One hundred concurrent claims produce at most one authority holder per item. Stale allocation acknowledgment denies new admissions while existing work continues. Report shadow versus actual placement differences.

implementationTasks.title: Unify host agent and drain role daemons
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Unify host agent and drain role daemons

Source: `docs/dynamic-placement/index.html` (AGT-3171). Read AGENTS.md, the relevant domain map, and AGT-3019 before editing. Use the Dossier recommendation as the working decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the selected option. Preserve Task Server attempt authority and platform-owned git operations.

## Deliver
Add one supervised host agent per machine with coding and review adapters using the existing Task Server claim, renewal, report and recovery contracts. Include persisted attempt inventory and per-role drain controls. Migrate a host by stopping new claims in the old daemon, reconciling every running attempt, then enabling that role in the host agent. Preserve release-mismatch and lease-loss behavior. Do not transfer an active lease to a second executor without authority reconciliation.

## Acceptance
A restart with one coding and one review attempt leaves one live authority holder each; each attempt finishes or is fenced with cleanup evidence. A role drain reaches zero old claims before the new adapter admits one. No duplicate completion or publication occurs. Document measured host-agent CPU and memory overhead and rollback to old daemons.

implementationTasks.title: Fresh Linux work container executor
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Fresh Linux work container executor

Source: `docs/dynamic-placement/index.html` (AGT-3171). Read AGENTS.md, the relevant domain map, and AGT-3019 before editing. Use the Dossier recommendation as the working decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the selected option. Preserve Task Server attempt authority and platform-owned git operations.

## Deliver
Implement a host-agent Linux Docker or Podman executor for one container per claimed item. Pin role image digests, release build/distribution and rollback. Apply the same AGT-3019 half-core grant as container CPU and memory limits; keep the host profile ceiling. Use separate writable attempt volume and versioned npm, NuGet and repository-mirror caches, exact-SHA verification, non-root execution, no host container socket, log flush, cleanup and orphan reconciliation by attempt/fence. Keep the Windows worktree process executor with bounded process tree.

## Acceptance
One hundred attempts leave no live container, secret mount or writable attempt volume after verified cleanup. Over-budget launches fail before work starts. Restart reconciliation cannot resurrect a fenced attempt. Measure p50/p90 grant-to-first-command, image pull, cache hits, cold repository materialization and gate wall time against current process/cgroup runs; record a numerical go/no-go threshold before broad rollout. Windows executes a Windows-only fixture without requiring Docker.

implementationTasks.title: Claim and pull every gate
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Claim and pull every gate

Source: `docs/dynamic-placement/index.html` (AGT-3171). Read AGENTS.md, the relevant domain map, and AGT-3019 before editing. Use the Dossier recommendation as the working decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the selected option. Preserve Task Server attempt authority and platform-owned git operations.

## Deliver
Extend the existing gate subject, claim and fenced report contract to merge, promotion and batch verification. Add a bounded immutable bundle artifact endpoint; the host downloads, size-checks and hashes the bundle, proves exact HEAD and policy digest, and reports command evidence. Resolve the current `BatchGate:Execution=claimed` remote Task Server identity rejection. Replace fixed remote SSH slot admission with a grant-backed host gate reservation while keeping per-branch merge/rollback locks and ordered publication. Drain existing SSH invocations before retiring bridge default; retain compatibility rollback until a canary passes.

## Acceptance
Wrong SHA or checksum fails before any verify command. Lease loss stops commands and prevents publication. Two hosts can claim distinct gates with no duplicate publication; same-branch publication stays ordered. Batch claimed mode works with the selected authority topology. A cancelled or restarted gate yields a terminal outcome and releases its grant; bridge and claimed results have equivalent evidence fields.

implementationTasks.title: Attempt credential broker and provider concurrency proof
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Attempt credential broker and provider concurrency proof

Source: `docs/dynamic-placement/index.html` (AGT-3171). Read AGENTS.md, the relevant domain map, and AGT-3019 before editing. Use the Dossier recommendation as the working decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the selected option. Preserve Task Server attempt authority and platform-owned git operations.

## Deliver
Bind a work identity to host, role, subject, attempt, lease, fence and epoch. Exchange it only after a valid claim and renewal. Implement an encrypted root-secret store with an external-store adapter boundary; issue one-repository GitHub App tokens with role-minimal permissions, renew with the lease, and revoke on teardown where supported. Inject Linux secrets as restricted tmpfs files, never secret values in environment or argv; use isolated Git helpers. On Windows use an ACL-protected encrypted-volume file adapter and record that storage mode. Run concurrent isolated Claude setup-token and Codex login-file refresh probes without copying an operator login; choose a login holder, separate accounts or approved API keys according to measured behavior.

## Acceptance
A stale fence cannot fetch or renew secrets. Read-role token cannot write or reach a second repository. No secret value appears in argv, environment, worktree, logs or artifacts. Teardown has revocation and deletion receipts; issuer outage leaves a bounded expiry. Two containers and a post-refresh canary produce a redacted concurrency report for both providers before any account sharing is enabled.

acceptanceScope.slice: Attempt credential broker and provider concurrency proof

implementationTasks.title: Show attempt and credential lifecycle
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Show attempt and credential lifecycle

Source: `docs/dynamic-placement/index.html` (AGT-3171). Read AGENTS.md and the frontend and tasks domain maps. Use D8 option A unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the option implemented. Preserve Task Server attempt authority and platform-owned git operations.

## Deliver
Project host, role, executor, attempt/fence, grant, lease state, age, image digest, cleanup status and cache outcome into AGT-3169 Environment view. Project credential kind, scope, issuer, expiry, binding, file storage mode and revocation receipt without value into AGT-3170 inventory. Use the same attempt and issuance records. Add relevant Playwright coverage and light/dark screenshots under the task results directory.

## Acceptance
A live container appears as a child of its physical host and leaves active occupancy after cleanup while its attempt receipt remains. Stale lease, failed cleanup and orphan states are visible. The inventory never returns credential values or token prefixes. Empty, running, terminal and orphan states are proven in both themes, with captions and provenance.

implementationTasks.title: Optional Kubernetes Job executor for existing clusters
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Optional Kubernetes Job executor for existing clusters

Source: `docs/dynamic-placement/index.html` (AGT-3171). Read AGENTS.md, the runner and tasks domain maps, and the recorded operator decision for D6. Implement this slice only for an installation that already has an approved Kubernetes cluster. Use D6 option A unless a later decision selects another option; record the option implemented. Preserve Task Server attempt authority and platform-owned git operations.

## Deliver
Add a Kubernetes Job executor behind the host-agent claim interface. The host agent claims first, reserves the AGT-3019 recommended grant, then creates a Job with CPU/memory requests and limits, attempt/fence labels, projected file credentials and a finished-Job TTL. Keep the Task Server as the sole authority for leases, results and publication. On lease loss, stop the Job and revoke its attempt credential. Reconcile Pod retries, reschedules and orphan Jobs without minting a second attempt.

## Acceptance
A Pod retry or reschedule never creates another Task Server attempt or publishes under an old fence. One hundred jobs leave no live Job, Pod or credential projection after the retention window. A cluster outage prevents new admissions but preserves fenced cleanup evidence. Windows work stays on its process executor unless a separate supported cluster profile is accepted.

acceptanceScope.slice: Optional Kubernetes Job executor for existing clusters

implementationTasks.title: Make post work claimable by the host agent
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Make post work claimable by the host agent

Source: `docs/dynamic-placement/index.html` (AGT-3171, AGT-3192), Post work and D9. Read AGENTS.md, the runner, pipeline and tasks domain maps, and `docs/operations/remote-task-server-local-studio.md`. Use D9 option A unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the option implemented. Preserve Task Server attempt authority, the shared AGT-3019 host grant, and platform-owned git operations. Coordinate the host adapter with S1 and S2; reuse S3 when a Linux container executor is enabled.

## Deliver
1. Persist a versioned post-work plan and per-step outcome in the Task Server. Give each ready host-capable step an immutable subject with card/run identity, step ID, predecessor hashes, exact result SHA or checked input bundle, policy/model digests, capability and resource requirements, deadline and idempotency key. Publish a claim, renew and fenced typed-report API through the existing host-agent admission contract.
2. Add a post adapter to the host agent. It claims only eligible ready steps with a current shared host grant, executes in an isolated attempt workspace, uploads bounded artifacts and cleanup proof, and stops on lease loss. The Task Server deduplicates reports, releases grants, unlocks successors once, and retains completeness, retry, lane, task-creation and publication decisions. Start with one host-capable deterministic step such as `post-regression-radar`; use existing Review and Gate subjects where a step already fits them. Keep workspace-wide drift and repository-writing producers backend-bound until their snapshot and fenced-write contracts exist.
3. Shadow the legacy backend queue from the `3-progress` to `4-auto-review` transition, reconcile the current lane and pipeline logs, then migrate one step kind per project. Drain or reconcile in-flight backend work before enabling host claims for that kind. Keep a scoped rollback path for unmigrated kinds; after cutover, rebuild ready work from durable plans rather than queue entries.

## Acceptance
A restart, duplicate claim storm and lease loss leave at most one accepted result per step and no stale-fence lane effect. Accepted output makes each successor ready once; step order and review verdict match the legacy canary. A backend crash after transition or a host crash after claim resumes from durable state within a bounded interval. Host occupancy includes post work under the same grant as coding, review and gate work. Legacy recovery does not redispatch migrated kinds. Backend-bound producers remain local until their required contracts and a separate cutover are proven.

acceptanceScope.slice: Make post work claimable by the host agent
